Blend model predictions with market probabilities

Source: R/models_baseline.R
blend_with_market.Rd

Creates a weighted average of model-predicted and market-implied probabilities. The optimal weight is found by minimising log-loss on a calibration set.

Usage

blend_with_market(
  model_probs,
  market_probs,
  actuals,
  weights = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)
)

Arguments

model_probs

A tibble with match_id, pred_h, pred_d, pred_a.

market_probs

A tibble with match_id, fair_h, fair_d, fair_a.

actuals

A tibble with match_id, ftr.

weights

Numeric vector of blend weights to try (default seq(0, 1, 0.05)).

Value

A list with best_weight and blended tibble.
